title: BoingBoinged
content: Thanks to Mark Frauenfelder for mentioningImaginative Realism on BoingBoing. It was a treat to meet the man behind so many fascinating posts. He's a good artist and a good dad, and he has a bemused, rumpled, curious air about him, something like a friendly mad scientist.I did a sketch in his book of a giant frog at a laptop, with the line "To Post is To Exist."-------More abouthow to get Imaginative Realism, signed and doodled in by me!Reviews onJohn Fleskes' Blogand onDrawn!and on theSpectrum blog.
